ltbt.board_seat_rights: Class T stock lets the Trust elect and remove a number of directors that phases in on time- and funding-based milestones, with a commitment to elect a majority of the board within 4 years of 2023 (T1). Anthropic stated on 2026-04-14 that Trust-appointed directors had become a majority of the 7-seat board; Jay Kreps (Trust-appointed) reportedly left 2026-05-22, leaving six directors. Trustees are chosen by existing Trustees in consultation with Anthropic, hold no equity and are paid only for time. RSP v3.2 (2026-04-29) added LTBT power to request external review of Risk Reports, approve reviewers and receive regular briefings. As of 2026-09-28 three trustees remain (Shah, Fontaine, Bernanke) after Cuéllar's exit; the Trust will pick a successor.
ltbt.ipo_changes: Per Reuters (2026-09-28) on the prospectus: a Founder LLC of seven co-founders directs a single Class F share carrying 50.1% of voting power over key matters including election of some directors; the LTBT elects four directors; Dario Amodei, Daniela Amodei and one other director are elected by Class F and Class A holders; four other share classes have limited functions. TechCrunch/The Information (2026-09-25): founders' voting bloc requires at least three of the seven to keep a minimum stake, founder board seats grow from two to three, the Trust still chooses most of the board, employees receive stock to break ties on some issues. Yahoo Finance (2026-08-20, citing Reuters/The Information) said the Trust would keep its right to elect a board majority through a special class of stock. The amendment thresholds for Class T/LTBT terms post-IPO are not public in sources opened by this desk.

Clarified AI R&D capability threshold definition; stated explicitly Anthropic remains free to pause development beyond RSP requirements; Frontier Safety Roadmap updated after two goals were met.
LTBT may request external review of Risk Reports, approve reviewer selection, and receives formal regular briefings.
Revised threshold for novel chemical/biological weapons production; refined off-cycle update approach for individual-model risks; terminology changes.

Revised automated R&D threshold; unredacted Risk Reports need only be shared with at least 200 employees (not all cleared staff); Risk Reports may use a coverage date; public reports must mark redactions; multiple external reviewers allowed.
